finalText:
**Big but mechanical.** 1082 lines across 94 files.

| Must not rename | Why |
| --- | --- |
| `vendor/reporting-sdk/` | Generated. `npm run vendor:refresh` overwrites it. |
| `docs/openapi.yaml` | Public contract. Renaming breaks every client. |
| `WIRE` values in [lib/serialize.js:8](lib/serialize.js:8) | Frozen public JSON key. |
| `migrations/` | Applied history. Editing breaks the down step. |
| SQL strings in repos, 125 lines | Real DB column, still `account_id`. |

Safe zone is variables and params in `services/`. That is the other ~1200 hits. Ask them if a column migration is planned.
